overall: GOOD in the north and west; MARGINAL in the south and on Tara/Turda currents
limiterDetail: Main limiter: wind in the south, plus current at Tara and Turda. Nangalao runs 14.9–15.4 kt until ~10 AM, then 11–14.4 kt, and drops under 10 kt from ~11 PM. Cabunlawan and Decabaitot run 13.7–14 kt this morning and 14–15.1 kt ~5–8 PM, easing under 10 kt from ~11 PM. Ciron peaks at 15.8 kt ~8 AM, then eases to ~6–8 kt by 4–6 PM. Tara's current builds from 0.8 to 1.5 kt by ~9–10 PM, and Turda's from 0.6 to 1.3 kt. Region-wide showers ~3–6 PM (about 0.8–1.6 mm/h). ECMWF rates Sun 18 GOOD for the day (6.6 kt, gusts 13, ~4.5 mm).

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR of gale, tropical cyclone wind signal and heavy-rain alerts for Calamian / MIMAROPA. Latest MIMAROPA item is still GFA #4 (Final), Region 4-B , Sat 17 Oct 5:10 AM PHT (advisory ended); nothing newer in the feed.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since yesterday afternoon
items: The good run got shorter, so shortage risk is back up from MILD to ELEVATED. ECMWF downgraded Tue 20 from GOOD to MARGINAL (current 0.5 kt; wind 7.5 kt, gusts 13, ~3.3 mm), so only Sun 18 and Mon 19 are GOOD now. The surge flag is OFF (was ON). Tue 20 through Sat 24 are all MARGINAL, and the worst day moved from Wed 21 to Thu 22 (12 kt, current 0.8 kt). Sat 24 now shows heavy rain (~18.5 mm).

This morning: 7 of 14 grounds are GOOD (up from 3 yesterday afternoon), and nothing is POOR. Mon 19 is still the week's best day. Binudac is now included in every rating and table. PAGASA is still CLEAR, and GFS agrees with ECMWF.

bestWindow.headline: Now–2 PM and ~7 PM–Mon 5 AM (Coron, Culion, Galoc, Maglalambay, Decabobo)
details: Now to ~2 PM: Coron, Culion and Galoc have 4.7–6.6 kt, 0.0–0.3 kt current and almost no rain. Maglalambay drops to ~3 kt from noon with 0.1 kt current. Decabobo has 1.4–6.8 kt and 0.2–0.4 kt current.

~7 PM to Mon 5 AM: after the showers, Coron, Culion, Galoc and Maglalambay drop to 0.8–3.1 kt (Maglalambay 1.2–5) with 0.1–0.4 kt current and only light drizzle. The model's best hour is ~Mon 2 AM at Galoc and Maglalambay. Alava and Binudac join from ~8 PM (2.6–4.5 kt, 0.1–0.4 kt current).

Go early at Turda (6–9 AM, current 0.6–0.8) and avoid Tara after ~9 AM. Keep boats off Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot until ~11 PM. Ciron is workable ~4–6 PM (6–8 kt) and again from ~11 PM (3–5 kt, 0.0–0.2 kt current).
